title: eludite.workspace.tree input
description: List the open workspace's projects as the Workspace window shows them, whatever their build system (`eludite/workspace/tree` of brief 0019): .NET projects of the open solution (kind csproj), Cargo packages of the Cargo workspace (kind cargo, with their targets) and, for a plain folder, the folder itself (kind folder). Optionally only one project.

project.description: Only the project with this name (as the Workspace window shows it).
